description: A comprehensive .NET library for creating type-safe, validated string and quantity types using semantic meaning. Transform primitive string and numeric obsession into strongly-typed, self-validating domain models with 50+ validation attributes, polymorphic path handling, arithmetic quantity operations, and performance-optimized utilities. Includes factory pattern support, dependency injection integration, and enterprise-ready features for building robust, maintainable applications.
